header.title: Join the <highlight>Closed Beta</highlight>
header.lead: Arena Legends v0.1.11, our first action game, is on the Google Play Closed Testing track. Help us tune its combat, campaign and controls before the worldwide launch. Time Hopper, our last beta, is now live on Google Play.

earlyBuilds.title: Exclusive Early Builds
earlyBuilds.text: Play Arena Legends v0.1.11 Closed Testing builds and future titles, like Nitro Racer, through Google Play before public release.

devAccess.title: Direct Developer Access
devAccess.text: Your feedback directly guides physics tuning, balance patches, bug squashes, and feature additions.

vip.title: VIP Tester Perks
vip.text: Receive exclusive in-game cosmetic badges, bonus coin packs, and tester credits in the final game release.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about participating in the SouMoster closed beta program

howWorks.q: How does Google Play Closed Testing work?
howWorks.a: Google Play requires developer accounts to invite trusted testers through specific closed testing tracks. Once we add your Google Play email, Google generates a private testing link allowing you to install the test build through the official Play Store app.

isFree.q: Is testing free? Are there in-app purchases during the beta?
isFree.a: Yes, testing is 100% free. Any in-app purchases enabled during testing use Google Play Test Billing (sandbox mode), which does not charge real currency.

android.a: Arena Legends and Road Hopper support Android 7.0 (API 24) and newer. Time Hopper and Bank Hopper support Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer. Space Hopper and Nitro Racer are still in development.

isOpen.q: Is Arena Legends Closed Testing open now?
isOpen.a: Yes. Arena Legends v0.1.11 is on the Google Play Closed Testing track. Submit your Google Play email with the form above; once we add you, opt in from the link and install from the Play Store listing. Time Hopper has finished testing and is live on Google Play.

trailers.q: Where can I watch gameplay and trailers?

feedback.q: How do I submit bug reports and gameplay feedback?
feedback.a: You can send feedback directly through the Google Play Store private feedback form, visit our <support>Support Page</support>, or email us at <mail>soumoster@gmail.com</mail>.
